uslaw-usc-t2-s179p:
Section 179p of Title 2 of the United States Code deals with a film collection. The collection is the National Film Registry Collection of the Library of Congress. The Librarian must try to get a top-grade copy of each named film. The copy should be a gift from the owner of the film.

The copy must be of the Registry form of the film itself. Where he can, the Librarian must seek the best stuff that still lives. That takes in the raw stock from which prints are struck. Owners and holders of such stock are urged to give it to the Library. The aim stated in the text is to keep the films safe for years. More goods tied to each film are sought for study and teaching. Scripts, reports from the set, and back-story goods are named there.
